---
title: "Your Presentation Title"
author: "Your Name"
institute: "Humane & Sustainable Food Lab, Stanford University"
date: "Event Name, Month Year, City"
output:
  beamer_presentation:
    slide_level: 2
    keep_tex: false
    pandoc_args: ["--lua-filter=suppress_title.lua"]
    includes:
      in_header: preamble.tex
    highlight: tango
    latex_engine: lualatex
classoption: "aspectratio=169"
urlcolor: blue
linkcolor: blue
params:
  show_title_slide: true
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Copy required files from package to working directory
pkg_resources <- system.file("rmarkdown/templates/foodlab_presentation",
                             package = "foodlabslides")

# Copy theme file
theme_file <- file.path(pkg_resources, "resources/beamerthemeFoodLab.sty")
if (file.exists(theme_file)) {
  file.copy(theme_file, "beamerthemeFoodLab.sty", overwrite = TRUE)
}

# Write preamble.tex. 0.6cm logo sits on the narrow footer bar
# (the look of the Oct 2025 Reducetarian deck)
writeLines(c(
  "% Food Lab Presentation Preamble",
  "",
  "% Load the theme",
  "\\usetheme{FoodLab}",
  "",
  "% Logo",
  "\\logo{\\includegraphics[height=0.6cm]{foodlab-logo.png}}"
), "preamble.tex")

# Write lua filter: removes title from pandoc metadata when show_title_slide=false,
# which prevents pandoc from generating \frame{\titlepage} entirely
writeLines(c(
  "function Meta(m)",
  "  if m.params and m.params.show_title_slide ~= nil then",
  "    local val = pandoc.utils.stringify(m.params.show_title_slide)",
  "    if val == 'false' then",
  "      m.title = nil",
  "    end",
  "  end",
  "  return m",
  "end"
), "suppress_title.lua")

# Copy logo file
logo_file <- file.path(pkg_resources, "skeleton/foodlab-logo.png")
if (file.exists(logo_file)) {
  file.copy(logo_file, "foodlab-logo.png", overwrite = TRUE)
}

knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)

# House style (see README): title, text left, one big picture right, under ~30 words.
# Add {.t} to slides with pictures so they start right under the title.
```
